Clank.name: Clank
Clank.description: Clanks are sentient mechanical beings built from a variety of materials, including metal, wood, and stone.

Drakona.name: Drakona
Drakona.description: Drakona resemble wingless dragons in humanoid form and possess a powerful elemental breath.

Dwarf.name: Dwarf
Dwarf.description: Dwarves are most easily recognized as short humanoids with square frames, dense musculature, and thick hair.

Elf.name: Elf
Elf.description: Elves are typically tall humanoids with pointed ears and acutely attuned senses.

Faerie.name: Faerie
Faerie.description: Faeries are winged humanoid creatures with insectile features.

Faun.name: Faun
Faun.description: Fauns resemble humanoid goats with curving horns, square pupils, and cloven hooves.

Firbolg.name: Firbolg
Firbolg.description: Firbolgs are bovine humanoids typically recognized by their broad noses and long, drooping ears.

Fungril.name: Fungril
Fungril.description: Galapa resemble anthropomorphic turtles with large, domed shells into which they can retract.

Galapa.name: Galapa
Galapa.description: Galapa resemble anthropomorphic turtles with large, domed shells into which they can retract.

Giant.name: Giant
Giant.description: Giants are towering humanoids with broad shoulders, long arms, and one to three eyes.

Goblin.name: Goblin
Goblin.description: Goblins are small humanoids easily recognizable by their large eyes and massive membranous ears.

Halfling.name: Halfling
Halfling.description: Halflings are small humanoids with large hairy feet and prominent rounded ears.

Human.name: Human
Human.description: Humans are most easily recognized by their dexterous hands, rounded ears, and bodies built for endurance.

Infernis.name: Infernis
Infernis.description: Infernis are humanoids who possess sharp canine teeth, pointed ears, and horns. They are the descendants of demons from the Circles Below.

Katari.name: Katari
Katari.description: Katari are feline humanoids with retractable claws, vertically slit pupils, and high, triangular ears.

Orc.name: Orc
Orc.description: Orcs are humanoids most easily recognized by their square features and boar-like tusks that protrude from their lower jaw.

Ribbet.name: Ribbet
Ribbet.description: Ribbets resemble anthropomorphic frogs with protruding eyes and webbed hands and feet.

Simiah.name: Simiah
Simiah.description: Simiah resemble anthropomorphic monkeys and apes with long limbs and prehensile feet.

Adaptability.name: Adaptability
Adaptability.description: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can mark a Stress to reroll.

Amphibious.name: Amphibious
Amphibious.description: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

Caprine Leap.name: Caprine Leap
Caprine Leap.description: You can leap anywhere within Close range as though you were using normal movement, allowing you to vault obstacles, jump across gaps, or scale barriers with ease.

Celestial Trance.name: Celestial Trance
Celestial Trance.description: During a rest, you can drop into a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

LqQvZJJLNMnFkt1D.name: Celestial Trance
LqQvZJJLNMnFkt1D.description: During a rest, you can drop into a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: When you succeed on an Agility Roll to move from Far or Very Far range into Melee range with one or more targets, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d12 physical damage to all targets within Melee range.

Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense
Danger Sense.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to force an adversary to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Very Close range.

Death Connection.name: Death Connection
Death Connection.description: While touching a corpse that died recently, you can mark a Stress to extract one memory from the corpse related to a specific emotion or sensation of your choice.

Dread Visage.name: Dread Visage
Dread Visage.description: You have advantage on rolls to intimidate hostile creatures.

Elemental Breath.name: Elemental Breath
Elemental Breath.description: Choose an element for your breath (such as electricity, fire, or ice). You can use this breath against a target or group of targets within Very Close range, treating it as an Instinct weapon that deals d8 magic damage using your Proficiency.

Endurance.name: Endurance
Endurance.description: Gain an additional Hit Point slot at character creation.

Fearless.name: Fearless
Fearless.description: When you roll with Fear, you can mark 2 Stress to change it into a roll with Hope instead.

Feline Instincts.name: Feline Instincts
Feline Instincts.description: When you make an Agility Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

Fungril Network.name: Fungril Network
Fungril Network.description: Make an Instinct Roll (12) to use your mycelial array to speak with others of your ancestry. On a success, you can communicate across any distance.

High Stamina.description: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

Increased Fortitude.description: Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage.

Internal Compass.name: Internal Compass
Internal Compass.description: When you roll a 1 on your Hope Die, you can reroll it.

Kick.name: Kick
Kick.description: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to kick yourself off them, dealing an extra 2d6 damage and knocking back either yourself or the target to Very Close range.

Long Tongue.name: Long Tongue
Long Tongue.description: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. Mark a Stress to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals d12 physical damage using your Proficiency.

Luckbender.name: Luckbender
Luckbender.description: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.

Luckbringer.name: Luckbringer
Luckbringer.description: At the start of each session, everyone in your party gains a Hope.

Natural Climber.name: Natural Climber
Natural Climber.description: You have advantage on Agility Rolls that involve balancing and climbing.

Purposeful Design.name: Purposeful Design
Purposeful Design.description:
Decide who made you and for what purpose. At character creation, choose one of your Experiences that best aligns with this purpose and gain a permanent +1 bonus to it.

Note: Automation isn't implemented for the permanent bonus. Manually increase the experience in the respective editing field.

Quick Reactions.name: Quick Reactions
Quick Reactions.description: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a reaction roll.

Reach.name: Reach
Reach.description: Treat any weapon, ability, spell, or other feature that has a Melee range as though it has a Very Close range instead.

Retracting Claws.name: Retracting Claws
Retracting Claws.description: Make an Agility Roll to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily Vulnerable.

Retract.name: Retract
Retract.description:
Mark a Stress to retract into your shell. While in your shell, you have resistance to physical damage, you have disadvantage on action rolls, and you can't move.

(When marked, manually enable the Retract effect to Active in effects tab and mark disadvantage when doing any action rolls. Manually disable the Retract effect to Inactive in the effects tab when no longer retracted into your shell.)

Scales.description: Your scales act as natural protection. When you would take Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

Sturdy.description: When you have 1 Hit Point remaining, attacks against you have disadvantage.

Tusks.name: Tusks
Tusks.description: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Hope to gore the target with your tusks, dealing an extra 1d6 damage.

klEyAxQa5YHXVnrl.description: You gore the target with your tusks, dealing an extra 1d6 damage on this attack.

Unshakeable.name: Unshakeable
Unshakeable.description: When you would mark a Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 6, don't mark it.

Wings.name: Wings
Wings.description: You can fly. While flying, you can mark a Stress after an adversary makes an attack against you to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.

zD3xVdwkEQi2ivOn.description: You to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the Adversary's attack.

Aetheris.name: Aetheris
Aetheris.description: Aetheris are humanoids most easily recognized by their wings and sacred markings.

Earthkin.name: Earthkin
Earthkin.description: Earthkin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and earth.

Emberkin.name: Emberkin
Emberkin.description: Emberkin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and fire.

Gnome.name: Gnome
Gnome.description: Gnomes are typically small humanoids with conical heads and the ability to teleport short distances.

Skykin.name: Skykin
Skykin.description: Skykin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and air.

Tidekin.name: Tidekin
Tidekin.description: Tidekin are humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and water.

Celestial Wings.name: Celestial Wings
Celestial Wings.description: You have wings that allow you to fly. Once per scene while flying, you can spend a Hope instead of marking an Armor Slot.

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.description: Spend 2 Hope to grant you or an ally within Melee range a +1 bonus to Evasion until you take Severe damage or you use this feature again.

Fireproof.name: Fireproof
Fireproof.description: You are immune to damage from magical or mundane flame.

Flicker Step.name: Flicker Step
Flicker Step.description: Once per scene, you can teleport to another point you can see within Far range.

Gale Force.name: Gale Force
Gale Force.description: Mark a Stress to conjure a gust of wind that carries you or a Very Close ally up to Very Far range. Additionally, you can always control the speed at which you fall.

Hallowed Aura.name: Hallowed Aura
Hallowed Aura.description: Once per long rest when an ally within Close range rolls with Fear, you can change it into a roll with Hope instead.

Ignition.name: Ignition
Ignition.description: Mark a Stress to wreathe your primary weapon in flame until the end of the scene. While the weapon is ablaze, it gives off a bright light, and you gain a 1d6 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

YWiD5AGYLBKvajs2.name: Ignition
YWiD5AGYLBKvajs2.description: While the weapon is ablaze, it gives off a bright light, and you gain a 1d6 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

Immovable.name: Immovable
Immovable.description: While you're touching the ground, you can't be lifted or moved against your will.

Lifespring.name: Lifespring
Lifespring.description: Once per rest when you have access to a small amount of water, you can mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point on yourself or an ally within Very Close range.

Nimble Fingers.name: Nimble Fingers
Nimble Fingers.description: When you make a Finesse Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

Stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
Stoneskin.description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Armor Score and damage thresholds at character creation.
